title: Challenges and Opportunities of Geothermal Drilling for Renewable Energy Generation
authors: C. Vivas; S. Salehi; J. D. Tuttle; B. Rickard
keyContribution: Summarizes high-temperature drilling, hard rock, fluid and construction constraints in geothermal wells.
limitation: Contextual review; does not validate a specific stability model.
decision: Identify geothermal-specific data and tool limitations before choosing a model.

title: Geothermal Drilling: A Review of Drilling Challenges with Mud Design and Lost Circulation Problem
authors: F. K. Saleh; C. Teodoriu; S. Salehi; C. P. Ezeakacha
keyContribution: Describes mud design and fracture-related loss control during geothermal drilling.
limitation: Reported cost fractions are context estimates, not universal well outcomes.
decision: Balance borehole support pressure against losses into productive fractures.

title: Review of directional drilling design and operation of geothermal wells in Indonesia
authors: B. T. H. Marbun; R. H. Ridwan; H. S. Nugraha; S. Z. Sinaga; B. A. Purbantanu
keyContribution: Connects geothermal directional-well design with operational constraints in Indonesian fields.
limitation: Regional experience; transfer requires local stress and thermal data.
decision: Screen trajectory and casing choices under geothermal conditions.

title: Context and mitigation of lost circulation during geothermal drilling in diverse geologic settings
authors: C. Winn; P. Dobson; C. Ulrich; T. Kneafsey; T. S. Lowry; J. Akerley; B. Delwiche; A. Samuel; S. Bauer
keyContribution: Compares loss mechanisms and mitigation in different geothermal geologies.
limitation: Cost and treatment outcomes remain field dependent.
decision: Diagnose fracture-controlled losses and select a response without assuming intact-rock tensile failure.

title: Real-Time Automated Fracture Detection in Geothermal Wells Using Low-Cost Drilling Data
authors: I. Mellal; M. A. Gabry; M. Y. Soliman; M. S. Khaled
keyContribution: Uses routine drilling data to flag natural-fracture intervals relevant to loss risk.
limitation: Fracture detection is a warning input, not a calibrated collapse or injectivity limit.
decision: Target pressure/loss diagnosis and follow-up measurements.

title: Real-time incident detection in geothermal drilling through machine learning
authors: A. H. Aspiras; S. J. Zarrouk; R. Winmill; A. W. Kempa-Liehr
keyContribution: Tests forward incident warnings from geothermal drilling data, including total-loss conditions.
limitation: An incident classifier does not identify every physical failure mechanism.
decision: Trigger timely investigation rather than replace geomechanical diagnosis.

title: A review on geothermal wells: Well integrity issues
keyContribution: Surveys geothermal casing, cement, temperature and chemical integrity hazards.
limitation: Does not provide a site-calibrated failure threshold.
decision: Define barrier monitoring and material assessment across service life.

title: A comprehensive review of geothermal cementing from well integrity perspective
authors: N. Arbad; H. Emadi; M. Watson
venue: Journal of Petroleum Science and Engineering 217, 110869
keyContribution: Summarizes geothermal cement placement and durability challenges.
limitation: Cementing evidence is not direct proof of open-hole rock stability.
decision: Plan cement design, placement checks and future barrier surveillance.

title: Failure mechanism and control method of cement sheath sealing integrity under alternating thermal-stress coupling in geothermal wells
authors: K. Deng; N. Zhou; Y. Lin; Y. Peng; K. Yan; H. Qin; P. Xie; Z. Li
validation: Model analysis of alternating thermal-pressure loads
keyContribution: Examines cement-sheath sealing and interface stress under production-injection cycling.
limitation: Model predictions require local material and cycling-history calibration.
decision: Assess annular sealing risk and thermal-cycle operating envelope.

title: Materials investigation of the high temperature IDDP-1 wellhead
authors: I. O. Thorbjornsson; G. S. Kaldal; B. C. Krogh; B. Palsson; S. H. Markusson; P. Sigurdsson; A. Einarsson; B. S. Gunnarsson; S. S. Jonsson
keyContribution: Documents high-temperature component failure experience from IDDP-1.
limitation: Wellhead evidence is peripheral to borehole-wall stability.
decision: Account for material limits when assessing service-life integrity.

title: A fiber optic approach for cement placement and hydration assessment of deep geothermal boreholes
authors: J. Hart; B. Polat; C. Wollin; M. Lipus; F. Schölderle; T. Ledig; P. Jousset; T. Reinsch; C. M. Krawczyk
keyContribution: Observes cement placement and hydration rather than relying only on discrete post-job checks.
limitation: Placement observation does not by itself prove long-term barrier integrity.
decision: Use construction records as a baseline for later integrity interpretation.

title: Study on Thermo-Hydro-Mechanical Coupling and the Stability of a Geothermal Wellbore Structure
authors: X. Huan; G. Xu; Y. Zhang; F. Sun; S. Xue
keyContribution: Models pore-pressure and cooling effects, including stress concentration near the cased/open-hole junction.
limitation: Predicted damage is model based and is not a field-validated threshold for other wells.
decision: Test injection temperature, pressure and junction stresses before setting operating limits.

title: Thermal Fracturing of Geothermal Wells and Effects of Borehole Orientation
authors: K. M. D. Hals; I. Berre
keyContribution: Shows modelled dependence of injection-induced wall fracturing on well orientation and injected-water temperature.
limitation: Scenario analysis; site-specific stress and temperature validation are needed.
decision: Check orientation and injection-temperature sensitivity of open-hole fracture risk.

title: Design of injection liner of high-temperature vapor-dominated geothermal reservoir
authors: B. T. H. Marbun; R. H. Ridwan; S. Z. Sinaga; B. A. Purbantanu
keyContribution: Recalculates liner loads, corrosion and injection-rate implications for a high-temperature injector.
limitation: One field case; liner design does not alone resolve rock fracture risk.
decision: Set injection rates and liner load limits with field-specific checks.

title: Casing setting depth and design of production well in water-dominated geothermal system with 330 °C reservoir temperature
authors: B. T. H. Marbun; R. H. Ridwan; H. S. Nugraha; S. Z. Sinaga; B. A. Purbantanu
keyContribution: Reassesses casing loads from construction through production, maintenance and possible conversion to injection.
limitation: A single well design study, not a transferable wall-stability criterion.
decision: Recheck casing loads when repurposing or intervening in a geothermal well.

title: Casing failure identification of long-abandoned geothermal wells in Field Dieng, Indonesia
authors: B. T. H. Marbun; R. H. Ridwan; S. Z. Sinaga; B. Pande; B. A. Purbantanu
modelType: Field integrity assessment and workover planning
keyContribution: Combines historical data, casing assessment and obstruction diagnosis before planned reactivation.
limitation: Missing design and cement records limited definitive failure attribution and workover planning.
decision: Inspect obstruction, casing and cement before declaring a shut-in well fit for workover.

title: Reconstruction of geothermal boreholes in Poland
authors: W. Bujakowski; B. Bielec; M. Miecznik; L. Pająk
keyContribution: Describes caliper/camera-based casing diagnosis and repair, including a leaking geothermal injection well.
limitation: Reconstruction outcomes are well-specific; not a generic stability model validation.
decision: Use logs and integrity tests to scope repair before returning a well to service.

title: The Sealing Performance of Cement Sheaths under Thermal Cycles for Low-Enthalpy Geothermal Wells
keyContribution: Measures cement sealing during low-enthalpy production and shut-in cycles in a 1.5-m annular setup.
limitation: Low-enthalpy laboratory load path; should not be generalized to high-temperature injectors.
decision: Check cement barrier response to the actual cycle amplitude and pressure history.
